Field Name
Description
customerIDString
Unique ID assigned by CrowdStrike for each customer.
eventType
DetectionSummaryEvent
offset
Starts at offset=0. Each new event would increase the offset counter by one. When reconnecting to the Falcon Streaming API, you can
specify the offset value to tell the API the starting point where you’d like to receive the events. If omitted, the API would return all
previous Detection Summary or Authentication events starting with offset=0.
eventCreationTime
Time when this event was generated in Unix epoch time.
